newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end mixed.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end mixed.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures ended mixed after directionless and narrow-range trade on Wednesday, traders said.
Prices ranged from 70 yen per tonne lower to 10 yen firmer, with the benchmark November 1997 contract rising 10 yen to 13,900 yen per tonne. Daily volume was 31,636 lots.
The market received little support from the yen's fall against the dollar.
"Market players were generally sidelined ahead of the U.S. Thanksgiving holiday on Thursday. Activity was mainly dominated by position-adjustment," one trader said.
The spot December contract on the CBOT Project A trading system was being traded at $2.73-1/2 per bushel at 0826 GMT, against $2.73-1/4 at Tuesday's close.
The spot January contract of the CBOT soybean futures on the overnight trading system was being traded at $7.15 per bushel at 0826 GMT, against $7.13 at Tuesday's close.
